integrity: Exact finite proof certificates and a standalone Python 3 standard-library checker accompany the statements; same-model scientific review only.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the eight-vertex Wagner graph and ordinary four-cut parameter. Complete integral homotopy type and the induced homology character are proved; no equivariant homotopy model, larger-ladder theorem, or independent audit is claimed.
title: The Wagner graph four-cut complex: a two-sphere and its dihedral orientation character
